zh-CN.title: 主角按键设置更顺手
items: 主角按键移至个人名片下方，统一入口卡片并提供独立设置面板
登场方式、音乐和接收设置即时保存，无需单独确认
修复嵌套设置中候选弹窗的关闭干扰

en.title: Simpler entrance key settings
items: A matching entrance key card below profile customization opens its own settings drawer
Entrance mode, music and playback preferences save immediately
Fixed dismissal interference in nested option dialogs
